```javascript
import users from './users.json' with {type:'json'};

const TOOL_NAME = 'users_get_many';

const tool = {
  name: TOOL_NAME,
  description: 'Look up multiple users by their ids. Returns one line per id in the order requested, marking ids that are not found without failing the batch.',
  inputSchema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      user_ids: {
        type: 'array',
        items: { type: 'string' },
        minItems: 1,
        maxItems: 5,
        uniqueItems: true,
        description: 'User ids to look up. 1-5 unique strings.'
      }
    },
    required: ['user_ids'],
    additionalProperties: false
  }
};

function validateArgs(args) {
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');
  }
  const keys = Object.keys(args);
  if (!keys.includes('user_ids')) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: "user_ids" is required');
  }
  if (keys.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid arguments: unexpected field(s): ${keys.filter(k => k !== 'user_ids').join(', ')}`);
  }
  const { user_ids } = args;
  if (!Array.isArray(user_ids)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: "user_ids" must be an array');
  }
  if (user_ids.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: "user_ids" must not be empty');
  }
  if (user_ids.length > 5) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: "user_ids" must contain at most 5 entries');
  }
  for (const id of user_ids) {
    if (typeof id !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('Invalid arguments: "user_ids" entries must be strings');
    }
  }
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const id of user_ids) {
    if (seen.has(id)) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid arguments: duplicate user id "${id}"`);
    }
    seen.add(id);
  }
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [tool];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== TOOL_NAME) {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  validateArgs(args || {});
  const lines = args.user_ids.map(id => {
    const user = users[id];
    return user ? `${id}: ${user.name}` : `${id}: not found`;
  });
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: lines.join('\n') }]
  };
}
```
